bubble-point pressures were successfully measured for three binary mixtures consisting of linear siloxane molecules.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the binary interaction parameters for linear siloxanes are not constant and depend on the temperature and the composition of the mixture.
the bubble-point pressures of the linear siloxanes can be modeled with a multicomponent Helmsoltz energy model with a reasonable accuracy.
the bubble-point measurements and binary interaction parameters obtained in this work are useful for future studies on the phase behavior of mixtures containing linear siloxanes.
